thread:
Zoe: Dropping a compact mock for the Usage header. Two variants: A) left rail with scope + date + download, B) single top bar with dropdown actions. Need quick opinions on discoverability and keyboard accessibility. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-header (page 'Compact Header').

Mark: Leaning top bar for simplicity on small screens. But put a visible 'Download (CSV)' button instead of just an icon so it's discoverable. Keep the org/project pill left so context is obvious.

Priya: Agree with Mark. Also callout: the token label should read "Tokens (in+out)" not just "Tokens"  customers confuse this. Tooltip: "Counts request and response tokens".

Zoe: Good catch. For the download menu I propose default CSV, caret menu for PDF/per-project. Default action starts CSV stream and shows a non-modal toast with link.

Mark: Perf note: PDF is expensive. Menu should show "PDF (may take ~2m)". Also when user selects per-project CSV, backend should stream a zip and we add a progress toast.

Priya: Accessibility: a11y-bot, please check that the download button has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, that the pill is tabbable with left/right arrow support, and that chart updates are announced via aria-live.

Zoe: Small a11y copy: add a hidden desc for the chart like `span.sr-only "Spend chart for {scope}, showing tokens and USD"`. Also ensure focus stays on controls after toggles.

a11y-bot: queued quick-scan on branch feature/compact-usage. Preliminary: download toggle missing aria-haspopup, pill needs role="tablist"/role="tab" semantics for arrow keys, contrast pass OK after bumping token chip to 14px. Full report URL: https://ci.redwood.ai/a11y/712

Mark: Decision summary: Top bar header with visible "Download (CSV)" + caret for options, org/project pill left, tooltip for tokens label, CSV default, PDF & per-project as menu items with ETA. Owners: Zoe (design mock + GIF keyboard demo), Priya (copy + tooltips), Mark (backend endpoints + progress toasts).

Zoe: I'll update figma and add keyboard journey. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
